design_system.name: Edumotion XI
design_system.philosophy: Warm Editorial Minimalism. Breaking the 'generic edtech' mold by treating the platform like a high-end curated digital magazine. We use asymmetric layouts, archival index structuring, and warm depth to build a focused, trustworthy, and distraction-free student experience.

fonts.setup_instructions: Import via Google Fonts or Fontsource. If Cabinet Grotesk is unavailable, fallback to 'Outfit'.

scales.overline: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono font-medium text-stone-500

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: 12-column CSS Grid. Use 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12' for main layouts.
layout_and_spacing.bento_strategy: For the dashboard, use tightly packed Bento grids with 'gap-6'. For marketing/homepage, use asymmetrical 'gap-8' to 'gap-12'.
layout_and_spacing.container_paddings: Generous spacing: use 'p-8', 'p-12', or 'py-20' for sections.

buttons.primary: bg-[#7B1E1E] text-white hover:bg-[#631818] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F5B400] text-[#292524] hover:bg-[#D99E00] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#E7E5E4] text-[#292524] hover:border-[#7B1E1E] hover:text-[#7B1E1E] bg-transparent rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold transition-colors

cards.base: bg-white border border-[#E7E5E4]/50 rounded-[20px] p-8 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(123,30,30,0.03)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(123,30,30,0.08)] transition-all duration-300

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#FAF9F6]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E7E5E4]

icons.style: Simple outline, stroke-width 1.5. Use primary or text.main color.

homepage.hero: Asymmetric layout (7 cols text, 5 cols image/illustration). Massive H1 in maroon. Search bar integrated directly into hero (not generic). Golden yellow CTA. Add subtle warm abstract shapes in background.
homepage.quick_access: 6 cards. Grid md:grid-cols-3. Icons floating on soft maroon/gold circular backgrounds.
homepage.choose_class: 4 large cards. Interactive hover states that expand to show subjects.
homepage.trending_chapters: Horizontal scroll or 3-col grid. Cards feature a thumbnail, chapter name, difficulty badge (mono font), and a golden progress bar.
homepage.reviews: Bento style masonry or smooth marquee layout with 'student portrait' images.

dashboard.layout: Control Room Grid but with warm aesthetic. Sidebar navigation + Main content area.
dashboard.welcome: Greeting with dynamic time. 'Continue Learning' card prominent at the top.
dashboard.stats_row: 4 bento boxes (completed, hours, tests, streak). Use large typography for numbers.
dashboard.calendar: Shadcn calendar customized with maroon accents for active dates.
dashboard.ai_assistant: Floating Action Button (FAB) bottom right. Maroon background with a golden spark icon. Opens a minimal chat interface.
dashboard.badges: Visual tokens using emojis and gold colors (🔥, 📚, 🏆, ⭐).

search_page.layout: Left sidebar for filters (Class, Subject, Type). Right main area for results. Archival list view for results.

chapter_page.layout: Tabs component (Shadcn customized). Clean, readable area for PDF/Notes. Embedded video player with soft rounded corners. AI Doubt section adjacent to content.

hero_backgrounds.description: Quiet library scene with people reading and studying in a warmly lit environment. Use in hero or generic backgrounds.
College students studying in a modern library. Use for 'About Us' or feature sections.

abstract_shapes.description: Dynamic shadows create an abstract pattern on an orange wall. Use for subtle background textures or hero accents.

student_portraits.description: Positive African American male learner with toothy smile in eyeglasses. Use in Reviews section.
Confident young man with glasses smiling in a library. Use in Reviews section.

technical_and_accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, search) MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., 'data-testid="search-submit-button"').
technical_and_accessibility.contrast: Text colors must meet APCA/WCAG AA standards. Ensure white text on maroon bg, and dark stone text on golden yellow.
technical_and_accessibility.motion: Use 'framer-motion' for page transitions and card hovers. Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion'. Staggered entrance animations for lists (Dashboard stats, Quick Access cards).
technical_and_accessibility.shadcn_customization: Override default styles. Make borders lighter (#E7E5E4), increase padding in cards, use 'rounded-[20px]', and override active states to use Maroon.
technical_and_accessibility.file_structure: Use standard .js and .jsx files for React components.
